label: Secrets
description: Secure storage and retrieval of named secrets using a password-protected vault.

credentials.description: Credentials used to initialize or unlock the vault.

password.description: Master password. Never persisted or logged.

secretInfo.description: Non-sensitive metadata describing a stored secret.

initialize.description: Creates a new encrypted vault and leaves it unlocked. Fails if already initialized.

unlock.description: Unlocks an existing vault. Invalid credentials never modify the vault.

lock.description: Locks the vault and discards active in-memory cryptographic keys.

list.description: Lists secret identifiers without exposing values. Requires an unlocked vault.

get.description: Decrypts and returns a secret, or undefined if absent. Requires an unlocked vault.

set.description: Encrypts and stores a secret, replacing any existing value. Requires an unlocked vault.

delete.description: Removes a secret if present. Requires an unlocked vault.

secrets:status-changed.description: Emitted when the vault lifecycle state changes.
